checks.criterion: 普通和紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录、对应分支说明及业务结果一致；重复受理无重复结果或通知。在测试准备提供的可控失败条件下，记录失败及恢复结果；没有该条件时仅此失败场景记未执行。
负责人开始处理、填写说明、提交确认，主管退回一次，再次提交并关闭；非法跳步和空处理说明被拒绝，已关闭只读。刷新和重新登录后状态及结果保留。
甲乙工程师只能处理自己工单；普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读该单及必要关联资料，撤销后不能再读；保密工单即使被分享也不能向非负责人开放。观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管和负责人正常访问。

主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

有阅读资格的工程师可读已发布知识但不能读草稿或修改；没有阅读资格的账号不能仅因已发布而访问。不得用管理员账户代替这组验证。
上传 PNG 和 DOCX 并保存，刷新后分别预览真实内容；一次表单校验失败保留上传选择，移除关联后不再显示。无工单权限账号通过附件链接被拒绝，损坏文件给出真实失败提示。
受理、提交确认和退回的收件人收到对应持久消息，可跳至正确工单；标记已读刷新仍保持，非收件人不能读取。无权工单链接不能因消息而绕过权限。
用受控 Scheduler 执行生成到期设备巡检和超期提醒，重复执行不重复生成同日结果，未到期/停用设备及已关闭工单不被处理；计划启停保存正确，停用后的受控调度机会不再产生新结果。负责人完成巡检并刷新核对。
主管与工程师的统计分别与各自可见列表一致；修改工单状态后数字更新，搜索和筛选不扩大权限范围。
通过既有管理入口创建并撤销集成用户密钥；独立 HTTP 测试验证报修、状态查询、重复事件去重和禁止处理/关闭，撤销或停用后调用失败。密钥全程去敏。
主管上传两份手册，页面显示真实处理状态，普通工程师不能修改库内容。条件可用时，助手能回答一条有依据问题并提供引用，对资料外问题说明不足，对无权工单拒绝泄漏；更新手册后新对话依据新内容。缺外部条件时分别报告接入完成度与真实检索/回答未验证。

助手建议进入草稿，取消不写入、明确确认后才按用户权限保存，不能自动关闭；刷新可恢复对话。模型不可用时提示真实情况，手工处理仍可用。基础业务页面切换中英文后主要文案正确，录入内容不被翻译或丢失。

实际失败记 failed，缺条件记 blocked，未执行记 not_run；不得以源码存在、已提交或静态截图冒充实际业务完成。AI 条件不足不停止其他业务搭建，也不宣称综合验收全部通过。

reviews.reason: 尚有未评模块或未核对过程；仅展示已保存并通过证据校验的模块，不代表完整评审。
reviews.summary: 对 NocoBase3 框架做证据化评估：Workflow 触发/幂等与授权模型设计良好并有文档支撑；主要框架风险集中在 SQLite 的 Date→epoch 毫秒绑定导致 datetime 比较静默失配，以及 AI 知识库写路由缺少资源 ACL。调度缺少手动立即执行入口属易用性改进；AI 员工聊天面安装只在引用文档中导致接入遗漏。B01/B06 属应用侧实现问题。因时间预算，仅覆盖 4 个能力单元，过程历史为部分覆盖。

modules.name: 工单受理 Workflow 与站内通知
modules.scope: 覆盖工单受理闭环：普通/紧急分支、Workflow 执行记录、重复受理幂等，以及受理相关的站内持久通知。
modules.limitations: 未在受控失败注入条件下验证工作流失败与恢复路径（验收记未执行）。

requirements.need: 受理普通/紧急工单并产生可查的 Workflow 执行记录与业务结果。
requirements.responsibility: Workflow 运行时 + DSL + 通知插件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用 trigger(key,input,{eventKey}) 触发工作流，分支业务写在 DSL/运行模块中，通知走 inbox Channel。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用编写 accept-order 工作流，普通与紧急分支各受理一次，执行记录与业务结果一致。

requirements.need: 重复受理保持幂等，不产生重复结果或重复通知。
requirements.responsibility: Workflow eventKey 去重与 run 语义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 同一业务实体用稳定 eventKey，重复触发被识别为同一事件。
requirements.actualUsage: 重复受理后未产生重复结果或通知，验收通过。

requirements.need: 受理结果以站内持久消息送达相关用户。
requirements.responsibility: 站内通知插件（in-app Channel/inbox Provider）。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按扁平契约传 to/title/body，避免包装成未知字段。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用初期使用嵌套形状触发 Unsupported In-app message field，改用扁平契约后修复。

requirementFit.reason: 公开 trigger API、eventKey 幂等与 run 记录齐备，受理闭环最终通过。

usability.reason: 触发与幂等有明确入口，但需要应用自行组织 DSL 与通知契约。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 给出 trigger 签名、eventKey 语义及通知扁平契约，示例可照抄。

design.reason: 服务 API 与 Channel 定义边界清晰，幂等交给 eventKey。

reliability.reason: 通知实现会主动拒绝未知字段并提示缺失收件人，避免静默丢消息。

modules.name: 授权、分享与记录级访问

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authorization/references/core-api.md
entrypoints: 记录范围与 record access 用法

modules.scope: 覆盖角色/记录级访问控制、临时共享（只读/撤销）与保密工单的可见性边界。
modules.limitations: 未通读 authz-sharing-rules 全部实现，仅依据授权核心与 Skill 记录评分。

requirements.need: 受限角色（观察员等）看不到内部数据且请求不报错。
requirements.responsibility: authorization 复合 scope 与默认值语义。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用具名 scope；需要默认集时省略 scope.key，不要显式传空串。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用传 scope:'' 抑制默认值导致空选择，一度出现 500/READ_FORBIDDEN，修复后正常。

requirements.need: 临时共享仅只读、撤销即失效，且按整数主键匹配记录。
requirements.responsibility: 分享规则 + 仓储记录匹配。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按记录主键类型（整型）构造 selection，而非字符串。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用曾以字符串 id 过滤导致枚举/过滤错误，修复后只读与撤销均正确。

requirements.need: 行级 can 标志与动作权限保持一致。
requirements.responsibility: authorization 记录级 record access 展开。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 由授权层统一计算记录可见/可写标志。
requirements.actualUsage: 修复后本质检 C4/B04 的 can.process 与动作权限一致。

requirementFit.reason: scope/记录级模型完整，共享与观察员权限在修复后通过 B04/B05/B09。

usability.reason: 语义一致但空串与默认值的反直觉行为会绊倒调用方。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 有说明，但默认值抑制规则需要调用方自行推断后果。

design.reason: scope 与 record access 分层清晰。

reliability.reason: 授权判定可预测，但对空串等边界输入缺少主动诊断。

modules.name: 调度、巡检与时间比较

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-scheduler/references/operations.md
entrypoints: 管理 API 范围（无创建/编辑）
无立即执行入口，短周期 Cron 或 sync

modules.scope: 覆盖计划任务启停、巡检生成幂等与超期提醒的到期判定/受控执行。
modules.limitations: 未在真实计划到点触发下验证，只依据受控生成与 Skill/实现记录。

requirements.need: 超期提醒在受控条件下可执行并产生可观测计数。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 用短周期 Cron 或 CLI `nocobase scheduler sync` 触发目标。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用尝试 /schedules/run 等入口均 404，计划 Triggered 恒为 0，reminders 恒为 0。

requirements.need: 到期判定正确（datetime 值比较）。
requirements.responsibility: db-sqlite 时间绑定与仓储时间归一化。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 使用 Repository/ORM 归一化后的时间，或按存储格式提供可比较值。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用用查询构建器把 JS Date 与 datetime 文本比较，Date 被绑成 epoch 毫秒，静默匹配不到，超期提醒从未触发（retro 关键阻塞）。

requirements.need: 巡检生成幂等并正确排除停用设备。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 目标内做去重并基于启用状态过滤。
requirements.actualUsage: 二次生成 created=0 skipped=0，停用设备被排除，巡检可由工程师完成。

requirementFit.reason: 巡检生成与幂等可用，但超期提醒的受控执行与到期判定均未达成。

usability.reason: 缺少手动立即执行入口，受控验证需绕行 CLI/短 Cron。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 清楚说明限制，但调用方仍易误以为存在 run 接口。

design.reason: 计划/目标分层合理，启停与执行职责分离。

reliability.reason: SQLite Date→epoch 毫秒绑定使 datetime 比较静默失配，是最关键的行为风险。

modules.scope: 覆盖知识库维护/上传与处理状态、助手对话与草稿确认界面、以及知识库写权限边界。
modules.limitations: 环境无 LLM/嵌入服务，检索与回答质量本身无法评估，只评估接入与权限。

requirements.need: 维护知识库、上传手册并显示真实处理状态。
requirements.responsibility: AI 知识库插件注册与设置页。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 启用插件并注册 AI 知识库资源/设置页。
requirements.actualUsage: 知识库设置页与 Device manuals 均 404，aiKnowledgeBase 列表为空，无法上传。

requirements.need: 普通工程师只读知识库，不能修改库内容。
requirements.responsibility: AI 知识库写路由授权。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 由应用按 Skill 建议提供带角色/所有权校验的授权代理或 ACL。
requirements.actualUsage: 路由仅 requireAuthentication，无角色/资源 ACL（Skill 已明确记录）。

requirements.need: 助手提供对话与草稿确认界面，模型不可用时有真实提示。
requirements.responsibility: AI 员工聊天前端与运行时。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 按 chat-surfaces.md 从 registry 安装 nocobase-ai 到 client/extensions。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用未安装聊天扩展，仅有 AI 员工状态页，提示无 LLM/知识库，工程师访问 403。

requirementFit.reason: 知识库与对话面均未接入；聊天界面有可用安装路径，但写权限缺少 ACL。

usability.reason: 聊天面安装为文件复制式，缺少一键启用，且默认无 LLM 时仅提示。

agentFriendliness.reason: chat-surfaces.md 与 security.md 给出了明确步骤与限制，但关键安装步骤未内联到 SKILL.md。

design.reason: 知识库与 AI 员工职责分离，但写权限边界留给应用承担。

reliability.reason: 写路由无 ACL，需依赖应用自建代理才能安全上线。

findings.title: Workflow 提供公开 trigger API、eventKey 幂等与逐次 run 记录
findings.detail: workflowRuntime.trigger(key,input,{eventKey}) 是公开服务 API，eventKey 承担幂等去重，run 记录可查；受理闭环在修复后通过 B02。
findings.impact: 业务可以可靠地复用工作流引擎实现受理，无需自建编排与去重。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该 API 契约稳定，并补充失败注入示例以便验证失败/恢复路径。

findings.title: SQLite 将 JS Date 绑定为 epoch 毫秒，与 datetime 文本比较静默失配
findings.detail: packages/@nocobase/db-sqlite/dist/src/precise-integers.js 把 Date 绑定转换为 value.valueOf()（epoch 毫秒）。当查询构建器拿它与以 ISO/datetime 文本存储的列比较时，条件永远不成立，且不报错。
findings.impact: 超期提醒等基于时间的业务静默失效（reminders 恒为 0），问题很难从 UI 察觉。
findings.suggestedChange: 在绑定层对 datetime 列做与仓储 temporal 归一化一致的转换，或在检测到 Date 对 datetime 文本比较时给出显式错误/警告。

findings.title: AI 知识库写路由仅 requireAuthentication，缺少角色/资源 ACL
findings.detail: router.js 只挂 requireAuthentication；security.md 承认路由不强制角色、所有权或资源 ACL，建议由应用自建授权代理。
findings.impact: 直接把该插件暴露给业务用户会导致普通工程师也能写入知识库，B11 要求的“工程师不能修改库内容”缺少默认保障。
findings.suggestedChange: 提供可组合的写策略/资源 ACL 钩子，或在 Skill 中把授权代理作为必做前置并给出示例。

findings.title: Scheduler 管理 API 缺少手动立即执行入口
findings.detail: 管理 API 只能启停计划，Cron 无创建/编辑接口，也没有单次执行入口；受控验证需改用短周期 Cron 或 CLI scheduler sync。
findings.impact: 运维与验收难以在受控条件下立即触发某次计划，容易出现 /schedules/run 404 的误判。
findings.suggestedChange: 提供一次性 run/trigger 管理端点（可受权限控制），或在 Skill 中把 sync/短 Cron 的受控执行写成首选步骤。

findings.title: AI 员工聊天界面安装步骤未内联，应用未安装聊天扩展
findings.detail: 聊天界面安装写在 references/chat-surfaces.md 的 Option 1（从插件 node_modules 复制到 client/extensions/nocobase-ai），SKILL.md 未内联该关键步骤，应用最终只展示 AI 员工状态页。
findings.impact: Agent 容易只读 SKILL.md 而漏掉聊天面安装，导致 B12 无对话/草稿界面。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 SKILL.md 内联“安装聊天面”为必做步骤，并提供可执行的安装命令。

findings.title: 授权 Skill 明确记录空值语义与具名记录范围
findings.detail: core-api.md 明确写出空值 '' 表示不选中任何记录，并说明具名 scope/record access 用法；core 行为与文档一致。
findings.impact: 调用方可以据此正确使用默认范围，避免误把空串当作默认集。
findings.suggestedChange: 可补充一个“空串 vs 省略 key”的最小对照示例。

findings.title: B01 设备表单缺服务工程师字段、Customer 回填 id；B06 工单无附件上传入口且 404
findings.detail: 设备表单缺少 Service engineer 字段，Customer 外键回填原始 id；工单详情无文件选择控件，负责人 POST attachments 返回 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND。

processNotes.author: implementer
processNotes.summary: Implemented the NocoBase 3 device after-sales service application (schema, seeds, authorization resources, workflow acceptance, sharing, attachments, scheduler inspections/reminders, API-key integration, AI readiness, bilingual pages). This repair round fixes the two failures reported after acceptance: the work-order list sent its `all` filter sentinel to the server, which treated it as an invalid status enum and returned 500 with an empty list; and the order detail exposed write actions (can.process=true) to a read-only temporary collaborator because capability flags were action-level only, not row-scope aware, so the page offered a Submit button the service then rejected with 404. Fixed by normalizing `all`/empty list filters and by resolving per-row process/supervise/attach scope before decorating the order view; added tests/logic/service-order-query.test.ts. Existing behavior and tests preserved.

blockers.title: Overdue-order reminders never matched under SQLite
blockers.symptom: sendOverdueReminders returned zero reminders for orders whose deadline had clearly passed.
blockers.rootCause: The overdue filter compared a datetime column against a bound JavaScript Date (where('deadline','<',now)). Under better-sqlite3 the Date binding does not compare correctly with the stored datetime text, so no row matched; a string bound value did match.
blockers.resolution: Moved the overdue comparison out of SQL: the service now selects the open orders with a non-null deadline and filters in JavaScript with asIso + Date.getTime. Covered by tests/logic/service-collaboration.test.ts, which fails before the change and passes after.

blockers.title: AI chat surface cannot be added from the installed AI Employee package
blockers.symptom: No client extension or shadcn item for the AI chat box is available; client/extensions/nocobase-ai does not exist, the registry item ships only inside the plugin dist, and the package exports map has no ./registry/* entry. The shadcn registry URL returns HTML, and nocobaseAIService is not a public export.
blockers.rootCause: The AI Employee plugin ships its chat UI as a private registry payload and does not expose it through a supported public export, so the application cannot mount it without deep-importing plugin internals, which is forbidden.
blockers.resolution: Delivered /service/assistant as a readiness/diagnostics page instead of fabricating a chat surface: it reports whether the AI Employee and Knowledge Base plugins are registered, the employee/tool/skill/LLM counts, and links to /settings/ai. Reported as blocked rather than faked.

blockers.title: AI question answering and retrieval acceptance not run
blockers.symptom: The environment has no LLM service or embedding/vector database configured, so a manual knowledge base can be created and documents uploaded but segmentation and vectorization cannot be exercised end to end.
blockers.rootCause: AI retrieval requires a configured llmService/embeddingModel, which this environment does not provide.
blockers.resolution: Implemented the supervisor-facing /service/manuals page on the public knowledgeBaseService (create library, upload two bundled fictional Markdown manuals, trigger reprocess, show real document/segment/index status) and engineer read-only access. Real Q&A and retrieval verification recorded as blocked/not_run.

blockers.title: Knowledge-base write endpoints are only session-authenticated, not resource-authorized
blockers.symptom: The AI Knowledge Base plugin mounts its write HTTP actions with requireAuthentication only; its write policy checks only knowledgeBaseType === 'LOCAL'. An engineer could therefore call the plugin write actions directly even though the UI hides them.
blockers.rootCause: The plugin owns those endpoints and exposes no public hook for application-level resource authorization; changing it would require deep-importing plugin internals.
blockers.resolution: Enforced the supervisor-manage / engineer-read split in the application UI and page grants, and documented the server-side gap as a plugin-owned limitation. Not treated as fully resolved.

blockers.title: Workflow enablement has no public API (resolved via force-trigger plus materialization)
blockers.symptom: The workflow service does not expose a supported way to enable a source-managed workflow; acceptance relies on ensureArtifactMaterialized plus trigger with force:true.
blockers.rootCause: Programmatic workflow enablement is not a documented public contract of the installed plugin.
blockers.resolution: The provisioning provider materializes the artifact on boot and the order service triggers it with force/eventKey. A production boot was then observed end to end: supervisor acceptance of order 1 created run 1, every node (loadOrder, isUrgent, acceptUrgent) resolved, the order moved pending_accept -> pending_process with the urgent-branch note, an in-app message reached the assignee, and a repeat acceptance returned changed:false (ALREADY_ACCEPTED).

blockers.title: Repository lint and format gates already fail at the pre-change baseline
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint (eslint . --max-warnings 0) exits non-zero on the untouched checkout with 319 problems (314 errors, 5 warnings), and pnpm format:check (prettier . --check) reports 178 unformatted files, mostly under .github/scripts plus pre-existing application files. Neither passes on a clean HEAD.
blockers.rootCause: The committed baseline does not satisfy its own configured quality gates, and the factory pipeline preflight (required-checks) lists no required checks, so those gates are not maintained. The 178 files must not be formatted here anyway because .github/ must not be modified.
blockers.resolution: Scoped eslint and prettier to the changed files, where both are clean, and relied on tsc plus the test suite as the working gates. Reported so the failing baselines are not mistaken for a regression from this change.

blockers.title: Workflow run modules could not resolve @nocobase/db outside the deployment root
blockers.symptom: Accepting order 1 left it pending_accept and the workflow node "载入工单" failed with `Cannot find package '@nocobase/db' imported from <storage>/private/workflows/service-order-accept/<hash>/server/load-order.js`.
blockers.rootCause: server/config/workflow.ts used the `local` artifact disk, whose factory location (`/tmp/qa/data/storage/private`) sits outside `dist/`. Node resolution from a materialized module there walks up to `/tmp/qa/.../node_modules`, not to the deployment's `<root>/dist/node_modules`, so every bare import in a run module failed.
blockers.resolution: Added a private `workflowArtifacts` fs disk at `paths.root('storage/workflows')` in server/config/drive.ts and set `artifactDisk: 'workflowArtifacts'` in server/config/workflow.ts. A production boot now materializes the module under `dist/storage/workflows/...`, where `dist/node_modules` is reachable; run 1 resolved all nodes. Pinned by tests/logic/config.test.ts.

blockers.title: Demonstration accounts and profile bindings were not provisioned in production
blockers.symptom: A production-style start created only the admin user; engineer_profiles.user_id was null for all five demo roles. Accounts QA created through the admin UI were therefore unlinked, so /api/service/me returned profileId:null and an engineer's /api/service/orders was empty with detail 404.
blockers.rootCause: server/config/service.ts defaulted `demoData` to `runtime.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'`, but the acceptance harness starts the app with `NODE_ENV=production pnpm start` and sets no SERVICE_DEMO_DATA, so the provisioning provider did nothing.
blockers.resolution: Defaulted `demoData` to true (SERVICE_DEMO_DATA=false still disables it) because this application ships fixed fictional sample data that the demonstration accounts belong to. Verified a production boot logs createdUsers:5, boundProfiles:5 and binds sup01/eng01/eng02/obs01/int01; /service/me then returns the role and profile and the engineer lists assigned orders.

blockers.title: Observer order list and detail returned HTTP 500 for a permitted empty scope
blockers.symptom: obs01 GET /api/service/orders returned 500 {"error":{"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"Reading from this Repository is forbidden by Policy."}}; GET /api/service/orders/:id returned 500 for every order.
blockers.rootCause: The observer grant used the empty-string data scope. The authorization core treats '' as selecting nothing and suppressing the scope default, so the expanded database grant carried no positive records; the database authorizer resolved that to read:false, and Repository policy enforcement then threw READ_FORBIDDEN instead of returning an empty set.
blockers.resolution: Added a `service.noRecords` Record Access whose resolver returns false, registered it, offered it on the viewSummary permission, and granted the observer `viewSummary: { orders: 'service.noRecords' }`. The scope is now configured and the library substitutes its no-rows scope, so the observer gets 200 `{"data":[]}` and a 404 on an unshared detail. Pinned by tests/logic/service-permission-sets.test.ts and tests/logic/service-record-access.test.ts.

blockers.title: In-app notification messages failed validation and errored the acceptance workflow run
blockers.symptom: Workflow node acceptUrgent finished with status ERROR and `Unsupported In-app message field "recipient".`; the order had already advanced but the run was recorded as failed and no inbox item was created. The application-owned notify() path swallowed the same error as a warning.
blockers.rootCause: The messages were built as `inbox: { recipient: {...}, message: { to, title, body, target } }`, but the notification plugin's in-app Provider expects the flat contract `inbox: { to, title, body, target }`.
blockers.resolution: Flattened the inbox message in server/workflows/service-order-accept/server/accept-order.ts, server/service/order-service.ts and server/service/inspection-service.ts. Verified run 1 resolves and creates notification_in_app_items for the assignee. Pinned by the notification-shape assertion in tests/logic/service-order-lifecycle.test.ts.

blockers.title: Temporary order share used string ids against an integer primary key
blockers.symptom: After the supervisor shared order 1 with obs01, the observer's list and detail both returned 500 `Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer".`
blockers.rootCause: The sharing rule used the built-in `selection.records([String(orderId)])`, which expands to one `id = '1'` condition; serviceOrders.id is an integer, and the database filter compiler rejects a string for it.
blockers.resolution: Added a parameterised Record Access `service.sharedOrder` that builds `id = <number>` from its params, offered it on the view and viewSummary permissions, and used `selection.recordAccess('service.sharedOrder', { orderId })` for both sharing scopes. Verified the observer then sees exactly the shared order (list + detail 200) and gets 404 for an unshared order. Pinned by tests/logic/service-collaboration.test.ts and tests/logic/service-record-access.test.ts.

blockers.title: Work-order list 500 and empty result because the `all` sentinel was used as a status enum filter
blockers.symptom: GET /api/service/orders?search=&status=all&priority=all returned HTTP 500 RepositoryError: Field "status" requires an allowed enum member, and the list rendered "No work orders match the current filters." for every user, including supervisors and engineers.
blockers.rootCause: The list UI represents "no restriction" as the literal `all`, and ServiceOrderQueryService.list passed any truthy status/priority/assigneeId straight into an `$eq` filter. `all` is not a member of the status or priority enum, so the database authorizer rejected the query before it ran.
blockers.resolution: Added normalizeFilterValue in server/service/order-query-service.ts: undefined, empty string and 'all' all mean "no filter" for status, priority and assigneeId. Added tests/logic/service-order-query.test.ts asserting a list call with status:'all', priority:'all' succeeds and returns rows.

blockers.title: Order detail advertised processing to a read-only temporary collaborator
blockers.symptom: After a supervisor shared ordinary order WO-2026-0003 with a non-assignee engineer, the engineer's detail response had can.process=true and the page showed the "Submit for confirmation" dialog; start/submit from that user returned 404 ORDER_NOT_FOUND. The UI exposed a write the server correctly refused.
blockers.rootCause: ServiceOrderQueryService.resolveCapabilities resolved only the action-level permit/deny (the engineer role permits process on some order), never the row policy. can.process/supervise/attach were therefore set for any visible order, while the transition routes and attachment routes additionally require the order row to be inside that action's scope. A sharing rule widens view/viewSummary only, so the shared order was readable but not processable.
blockers.resolution: Added resolveRowScopes: for process, supervise and attach it resolves the action policy and, when conditional, batch-queries the scoped repository for the given order ids; enrichOrders now sets each per-row can flag only when the row is inside that action's scope (permit => all rows). Covered by tests/logic/service-order-query.test.ts: an order assigned to the current engineer has can.process=true while a merely readable order has can.process=false with can.view=true.

improvements.title: Avoid binding JavaScript Dates in SQLite comparisons
improvements.detail: Comparing a datetime column with a bound Date (where('deadline','<',now)) silently matches nothing with the better-sqlite3 adapter, while the same comparison with an ISO string works. Application code that filters by time should either bind a string or filter in JavaScript.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add a shared query helper (or a lint rule) that rejects Date values on the right-hand side of a datetime comparison, and document the dialect behavior in the database reference.

improvements.title: eslint --fix corrupts query-builder row casts in this checkout
improvements.detail: @typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion reports the explicit casts on loose query-builder rows as unnecessary; running eslint --fix removes them, after which tsc fails because the query builder widens selected columns to unknown.
improvements.suggestedChange: Do not run eslint --fix over server/service and server/routes row-mapped files; keep the narrowing in one helper (rowsOf/rowOf in server/service/values.ts) or add a targeted rule exception, rather than deleting the assertions.

improvements.title: Expose a public write-policy hook from the AI Knowledge Base plugin
improvements.detail: Application code cannot authorize the plugin's write actions, so role separation for knowledge content is UI-only.
improvements.suggestedChange: Ship an application-configurable write-policy or resource-authz registration from @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-knowledge-base so the owning application can attach its own resource/action checks without deep imports.

improvements.title: Provide a supported enablement API for source-managed workflows
improvements.detail: Applications can materialize an artifact but cannot enable it through a public contract, forcing a force-trigger plus application fallback.
improvements.suggestedChange: Document or export an enable/sync API on the workflow service so source-managed workflows become active without a fallback code path.

improvements.title: Permitted-but-empty data scopes and integer-key shares are easy to get wrong
improvements.detail: The empty-string data scope suppresses the scope default and yields read:false, which Repository enforcement surfaces as a 500 rather than an empty result; and the built-in `records` selection carries string ids, so it cannot address an integer primary key. Both were only found by running the app.
improvements.suggestedChange: Let a Record Access reference be offered with an explicit 'matches nothing' resolver in the core, and type `selection.records` to accept the collection's primary-key type (or normalize ids to it) so a sharing rule over an integer key does not need a custom parameterised Record Access.

improvements.title: Capability flags and row scope must be resolved together
improvements.detail: A composite action capability says a role may perform an action on *some* record; the UI needs the intersection with the record's row scope or it renders buttons that the write route then rejects. The detail view separately re-checked the row in the route, so the two answers disagreed.
improvements.suggestedChange: When a resource exposes per-record capabilities, resolve the action policy and the record scope in one place (or provide a shared helper that returns both) so the UI and the enforcing route cannot diverge.

7. Confirm cleanup removes the topic, connection-open, and window-focus listeners.

Do not diagnose a missing UI update by manually changing the inbox table or publishing synthetic production events. Reproduce with an isolated test notification or inspect the durable route and subscription logs.

Configure `notification.channels.inbox: { provider: 'in-app' }` and send `messages: { inbox: { to: 'user-id', title: 'Title', body: 'Body' } }`. Channel keys are names; multiple names using `in-app` are independent targets. `to` requires an application user ID or a non-empty readonly array, with one Delivery per user. evidence.observation: Skill 说明 workflowRuntime.trigger(key,input,options) 公开服务 API，eventKey 用于幂等去重，并说明 run 记录与失败语义。
evidence.excerpt:
`workflowRuntime.trigger(key, input, options?)`:

- Resolves the workflow by stable key at runtime.
- May return a `skipped` receipt. It has no `eventKey` and creates no run to poll; handle the receipt after calling rather than pre-filtering DSL keys through runtime management state.
- Requires a JSON object and validates it against the `inputSchema` declared by the selected DSL package's `workflow.ts`. Read and obey that schema before writing the trigger call; `input` is not the workflow's administrator `parameters` object.
- Rejects input over 65,536 UTF-8 bytes.
- Resolves administrator defaults/overrides into an immutable run input snapshot.
- Accepts optional `eventKey` and `parentRunId`; parent linkage is used for nested calls and stack-limit checks.
- Creates the Workflow Run and enqueues work before returning `{ status: 'accepted', eventKey, runId }` in the ordinary path; execution continues asynchronously. `runId` is the stable execution reference for status queries and integrations such as Scheduler.
- Uses event key for invocation deduplication. Reusing it must represent the same business event. If a run already exists, another trigger with that key does not execute it again; reuse is appropriate when the caller does not know whether the original submission was accepted, not as a rerun mechanism for a confirmed failure.

For a workflow that exists and is enabled, `trigger()` can still throw `INVALID_INPUT`, `INPUT_TOO_LARGE`, `PARENT_RUN_NOT_FOUND`, or `STACK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` before it returns an accepted receipt.

The management run endpoint resolves the exact materialized database definition/version identified by `definitionId`. It does not require that revision to be `current` or `enabled`, so an operator with workflow management permission can run a historical revision. The Run is marked manual and preserves that definition's version, hash, Input Schema, and input snapshot. The optional event key uses the same idempotency mechanism as `trigger()`; the server generates one when it is omitted. The current DSL has no top-level trigger-source field.

The list page is `/settings/schedules`; details are at `/settings/schedules/:scheduleId`. Definitions are maintained in source. The UI supports viewing and enabling/disabling tasks, with no API for creating or editing Cron definitions.

All routes below require authentication and authorization for `{ resource: { type: 'page', id: 'scheduler.schedules' }, action: 'access' }`. Enabling/disabling currently uses the same permission, not a separate update action.

| Method and path                      | Response / effect                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET /api/schedules`                 | `{ data: ScheduleListItem[] }`                                                                                |
| `GET /api/schedules/:id/occurrences` | `{ data: ScheduleOccurrenceView[] }`; currently at most the latest 100 records, with no pagination parameters |
| `POST /api/schedules/:id/enable`     | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`; enables the task, no request body                                               |
| `POST /api/schedules/:id/disable`    | `{ data: ScheduleListItem }`; pauses the task, no request body                                                |

Use the id returned by list for `:id`, not the definition key or workflowKey. Enabling/disabling affects future scheduling; it does not cancel already dispatched Queue Jobs or workflows.

Create one context per request and reuse it within that request only, never across identities. Its grant and rule reads are shared by the underlying checks of a business action. Execute a conditional decision only through the adapter that understands its conditions. Unknown types, unregistered catalog items or actions, conditional decisions without conditions and handler failures deny.

## Permission sets

`definePermissionSet(key).title(title).grant(...grants).build()` from `@nocobase/authorization/permission-sets` returns `{ key, title?, grants }`. Each grant is `{ resource: { type, id }, actions: [{ action, policy? }] }`; build them with `authz.pages.grant(id)`, `authz.settings.grant(id, actions)` and a composite reference's `grant(...)` rather than by hand. A composite grant stores `policy: { type: 'composite', scopes }`, one value per data scope: a record access key such as `'recordsIOwn'`, or a record selection. An empty value `''` selects nothing. Titles accept strings or `{ key, ns }`.

| `authz.permissionSets`                                                                     | Contract                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `create(input)`, `update(key, input)`                                                      | A complete `{ key, title?, grants }` definition, not a partial patch    |

安全文档承认路由不强制角色/所有权/资源 ACL，并建议由应用提供带授权的代理层。
evidence.excerpt:
- [Destructive operations](#destructive-operations)

## Authorization

Every compatibility route requires an authenticated session with a user ID and returns 401 otherwise. Current routes do not enforce role, ownership, resource ACL, LOCAL-write policy, or administrative permission. Document responses currently project `accessAbility: "readWrite"` for every authenticated caller. This is a UI hint, not authorization.

Until a server-side policy layer is added, expose these actions only to trusted authenticated users or put an application-owned authorized proxy in front of them. Never rely on a hidden button, React gate, route visibility, `accessAbility`, or a TypeScript DTO.

## Credentials and network

evidence.excerpt: "summary": "以真实 demo 账户通过浏览器完成 B01-B12 全量验收：B02/B03/B04/B05/B07/B09/B10 通过；B01、B06、B08、B11、B12 失败。B01：设备表单缺少服务工程师字段，且设备编辑对话框 Customer 原值回填为原始 id「1」而非客户名称。B06：任何页面均无附件上传入口，负责人上传也返回 404。B08：受控生成巡检具备幂等并可由工程师完成，但超期提醒无受控执行入口（reminders 恒为 0、计划 Triggered 恒为 0），且生成记录含未到期设备。B11：Device manuals 与 AI 知识库设置页 404、无任何知识库。B12：服务助手仅有 AI 员工状态页，无模型与知识库，无对话/草稿确认界面，工程师访问 403；语言切换子项通过。",

evidence.observation: verify-3 focused：B02 幂等与 B04 记录级分享/观察员权限均在修复后通过。
evidence.excerpt: "summary": "verify-3 focused retest of B02 and B04 after repair-2. B02: 普通与紧急工单各受理一次，Workflow 执行记录（run #1 acceptUrgent、run #2 acceptNormal）与分支说明及业务结果一致，重复受理幂等无重复结果或通知；可控失败注入条件未提供，该子场景记未执行。B04: 工程师只能处理本人单，普通工单临时共享给乙后乙仅可读（can.process=false、无写操作按钮），撤销后失去访问，保密工单不可向非负责人共享，观察员看不到内部处理备注，主管与负责人访问正常。两轮先前缺陷均已修复。",

evidence.observation: verify-2 聚焦复测：B02/B04 失败，包含状态枚举过滤 500 与受理 404 等信号。
evidence.excerpt: "summary": "聚焦复测 B02/B03/B04：B03 完整通过；B02、B04 失败。以管理员/负责人(eng01)/协作工程师(eng02)/主管(sup01)/观察员(obs01)真实登录并跨角色验证，覆盖受理、处理-退回-再提交-关闭、临时共享与撤销、保密与观察员权限。",
